mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, title, authors, venue, abstract AS paperAbstract, upload_time AS uploadTime, citations, impact, status, paper_url AS paperUrl, note_url AS noteUrl FROM paper WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT d.dataset_id AS datasetId, d.dataset_name AS datasetName, d.description, NULL AS datasetUrl, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM dataset_task dt LEFT JOIN task t ON dt.task_id = t.id WHERE dt.dataset_id = d.dataset_id) AS tags FROM paper_dataset pd JOIN dataset d ON pd.dataset_id = d.dataset_id WHERE pd.paper_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS datasetId, COALESCE(pd.display_name, pd.dataset_url) AS datasetName, NULL AS description, pd.dataset_url AS datasetUrl, NULL AS tags FROM paper_dataset pd WHERE pd.paper_id = #{id} AND pd.dataset_url IS NOT NULL AND (pd.dataset_id IS NULL OR pd.dataset_id = 0) ORDER BY datasetName ASC
SELECT t.name FROM paper_task pt JOIN task t ON pt.task_id = t.id WHERE pt.paper_id = #{id}

SELECT r.id AS id, t.name AS task, d.dataset_name AS dataset, r.metric_name AS metric, r.metric_value AS value, r.is_sota AS isSota FROM result r JOIN task t ON r.task_id = t.id JOIN dataset d ON r.dataset_id = d.dataset_id WHERE r.paper_id = #{id} ORDER BY r.is_sota DESC, r.id ASC
